simple.meaning: אֲשִׁישָׁה (ʼăshîyshâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “something closely pressed together , i.e. a cake of raisins or other comfits.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 4 times across 2 Samuel, 1 Chronicles, Song of Solomon, Hosea, beginning at 2 Samuel 6:19. Its contexts include Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אֲשִׁישָׁה (H809).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: אֲשִׁישָׁה (ʼăshîyshâh) / H809 is traced through 2 Samuel 6:19, 1 Chronicles 16:3, Song of Songs 2:5, Hosea 3:1 as a generated source-based concept entry.

structuredEvidence.definition: something closely pressed together , i.e. a cake of raisins or other comfits

firstOccurrence.englishText: He gave to all the people, even among the whole multitude of Israel, both to men and women, to everyone a portion of bread, dates, and raisins. So all the people departed, each to his own house.

timeline.evidenceText: He gave to all the people, even among the whole multitude of Israel, both to men and women, to everyone a portion of bread, dates, and raisins. So all the people departed, each to his own house.
He gave to everyone of Israel, both man and woman, to everyone a loaf of bread, a portion of meat, and a cake of raisins.
Yahweh said to me, “Go again, love a woman loved by another, and an adulteress, even as Yahweh loves the children of Israel, though they turn to other gods, and love cakes of raisins.”

definitions.full: H809. ashishah אֲשִׁישָׁה noun feminine (pressed) raisin-cake — ׳א 2Sam 6:19 ; 1Chr 16:3 distributed, with other viands, to people; especially as stimulating, plural אֲשִׁישׁוֺת Song 2:5 ; more explicitly עֲנָבִים אֲשִׁישֵׁי Hosea 3:1 used in sacrificial feasts (compare RS OTJC Lect. xi. n. 7 ); חֲרֶשֶׂת קִיר אֲשִׁישֵׁי Isa 16:7 , i.e. the raisin-cakes which were an article of trade at Qir-hareseth (taken by Thes and others = foundations , i.e. foundations exposed by ruin, from [ אָשִׁישׁ ] with such a meaning). אֵ֫שֶׁת see אִשָּׁה below III. אנשׁ .
